regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. Before further delay this time I'll just write "Thank you" and God bless you for the favor just noted which you sent me spe- cial day-before yesterday. Also for a number of others never formally acknowledged. We are having 40 Hour Devotion till Tuesday- night and I hope to purpose to remember you all in Muskegon. I'l pray for yours,
